```yaml
name: Release Testing

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: [3.6, 3.7, 3.8, 3.9, 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, 3.14]
        freethreaded: [false, true]
    if: ${{ matrix.python-version != '3.14' || matrix.freethreaded == true }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          freethreaded: ${{ matrix.freethreaded }}
          cache: true
          architecture: x64
          check-latest: true
          allow-prereleases: true

      - name: Set up uv
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          activate-environment: true
          enable-cache: true
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --dev

      - name: Run tests
        run: uv run pytest -q
```
